name: HAKO Corta Arvore

origin.note: Written from scratch to reproduce publicly documented Minecraft tree-felling behaviour. Does not contain, derive from, or redistribute any third-party addon file. Inspired by the concept behind CurseForge's [Why Not] Chop Chop (author: daniswastaken), but shares no code with it.

gameplay_contracts: Agachado e com ferramenta, uma arvore natural reta derruba o tronco vertical inteiro.
Galhos diagonais (acacia, selva, carvalho-escuro) caem junto com o tronco, sem deixar pedacos flutuando.
Tres toras colocadas sem folhas nao sao tratadas como arvore.
Sem agachar, somente o bloco atingido quebra.
Ferramenta perto do limite de durabilidade respeita dano e quebra sem erro da Script API.
Uma parede ou torre de madeira proxima a uma arvore real nao e derrubada junto.

validation.static_check: passed (scripts/pack-tool.py check) - status review, no block-level findings
validation.note: Verified live on the HAKO Mac local server (Marvel Project world) across versions 1.0.0-1.0.4; 1.0.1 added diagonal branch felling, 1.0.2 fixed branches left floating mid-air by requiring only that some part of the branch touch a leaf rather than every step.
